bias.en: Downtrend · oversold bounce, still under the April low
bias.zh: 下行趋势 · 超卖反弹，仍在 4 月低点下方

read.en: Marvell rose 5.7% on Nov 6 to $141.20, trading between $135.34 and $146.32. It remains below the falling 5-day ($155.6), 10-day ($192.2), 30-day ($235.3) and 100-day ($232.2) averages and the rising 200-day ($185.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, the histogram no longer widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($219.50), and RSI is 26.
read.zh: Marvell 11月6日上涨 5.7%，收于 $141.20，盘中区间 $135.34–146.32。股价仍位于下行的 5 日（$155.6）、10 日（$192.2）、30 日（$235.3）和 100 日均线（$232.2）以及上行的 200 日均线（$185.1）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图不再扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月29日起看空（$219.50），RSI 为 26。

read.en: The bounce held above the $132.54 Nov 5 low, but the $146.32 high stopped just under the $146.85 April 28 low, which stays resistance. Resistance is $146.3–146.9, then $154.8–158 (Nov 4 low, 5-day, May 12 low) and $162.9–166. Support is $135.3 (Nov 6 low), then $132.5 and $128.4 (Apr 16 low). A close above $146.9 would target $155–158; below $132.5, $128.4.
